core_obligations: Construct W_p by removing all diagonals from the p-fold fibre product; the diagonals are open and closed immersions.
Every finite set of points of W_p lies in an affine open; S_p acts freely on W_p over X.
V_p = W_p/S_p is a separated scheme, etale over X; U_p is the open image, giving the filtration with the degree characterization.
Z_p = f_p^{-1}(T_p) -> T_p is etale, universally injective (bijective on k-points for algebraically closed k), hence an open immersion and an isomorphism.
Part (2): a quasi-compact field point gives a quasi-compact geometric fibre, finitely many points, hence x in some T_p.
proof_roadmap: W_p construction; free groupoid quotient; filtration definition; isomorphism over strata; part (2) finiteness.
difficulty_reason: A full stratification construction: diagonals, quotient scheme, filtration, and the stratum isomorphism, each a genuine step.
